data.exact_reserve_text:
There have been adverse movements on all underwriting years, apart from on 2007 where a release of claims reserves has resulted in an underwriting profit of GBP 8.3m on that year.

Due to the continuing uncertainty on the Italian Public Hospital Medical Malpractice reserves the Board of the Managing Agent has resolved to leave the 2007 year of account open. The Syndicate ceased underwriting this business from the 2008 year of account. However, the uncertainty over the ultimate cost of Italian Public Hospitals claims has reduced and a reserve release on the 2007 and prior years of account has resulted in an operating profit of GBP 8,334k for the financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: Italian Public Hospital Medical Malpractice reserves (Italian Public Hospitals)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Uncertainty over ultimate cost reduced leading to a reserve release on the 2007 and prior years of account which contributed to an operating profit for the financial year.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding increased slightly year-on-year, and the Managing Agent reports adverse movements across underwriting years generally. The exception was the 2007 year (and prior years) where reduced uncertainty in Italian Public Hospital medical malpractice claims resulted in a reserve release contributing to an GBP 8.334m operating profit for that year. No explicit gross prior-year development amount is stated for the portfolio overall in the notes; a gross claims development table is provided but the printed layout makes direct extraction of a single aggregated prior-year movement ambiguous.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse movements on all underwriting years
continuing uncertainty on the Italian Public Hospital Medical Malpractice reserves
uncertainty over the ultimate cost of Italian Public Hospitals claims has reduced
reserve release on the 2007 and prior years of account

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: A gross prior-year development (PYD) amount is not explicitly stated in a single gross figure. A gross claims development table (triangle) is present (page 35) but the printed rows/columns in the PDF extract are ambiguous to programmatically reconcile into a single aggregated PYD with high confidence. The report does explicitly state 'adverse movements on all underwriting years' and a reserve release on 2007 and prior (Italian Public Hospitals) producing an GBP 8,334k operating profit for that year, but that release amount appears presented as a year-of-account underwriting result and is not an explicit total gross PYD for all prior years. Consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null and the triangle is provided in raw form in _claims_triangle for possible human review.
